looks.title: White cathedral · hung rig
looks.intent: The roof frame and the columns as a nave of cold white: the column beams stand straight up in mirrored pairs, the booth's line opens a narrow apse fan behind the DJ. Everything else is dark — no PAR, no spot, no strobe.

looks.title: Red room · hung rig
looks.intent: Deep red only, and low: the columns and the press glow from their feet, the booth's beams stand still and dim in red, the DJ a dark shape against the red press. The column beams are out: the roof stays black.

looks.title: Strobe hit · hung rig
looks.intent: The peak: every strobe and blinder at full — the pit strobes rake up over the crowd from the floor, the header strobes and the blinders hit the front of the floor; every beam and PAR out, so the flash lands on black.

looks.title: Blackout + one beam · hung rig
looks.intent: Everything out but one: the beam on the floor right behind the DJ, straight up into the roof — the DJ a silhouette cut out of it.

looks.title: Slow sweep · hung rig
looks.intent: A held frame of a slow mirrored sweep: the column beams lean out toward the walls in pairs, the booth's line fans wide; the columns glow a low red underneath. Nothing flashes.

looks.title: Blackout + one shaft
looks.intent: Black. One thin white shaft stands straight up from behind the press into the roof, the DJ a silhouette cut out of it. Nothing else.

looks.title: Columns from below
looks.intent: The eight column faces glow cold white from their feet and fade to black before the roof; a low white beam at the foot of each far column. The floor is dark, the structure stands up out of it.

looks.title: Haze wall
looks.intent: Haze rolls from behind the DJ; all seven booth beams stand straight up in a row, a wall of light in the haze behind the silhouette; the rest is dark. EFFECT: hazers on (hazer-back, hazer-hall) — NOT SIMULATED.

looks.title: Roof reveal
looks.intent: The space-frame roof appears in pieces: the beams behind the press fan open into the trusswork, then the column beams stand up beside them; a dim white graze along the crane bridge above. Still, no sweep.

looks.title: Slow fan
looks.intent: The column beams lean slowly in across the nave, the wall beams lean slowly out toward the side walls, the booth beams open into a wide fan up into the roof. The move is the slow crossfade in from the reveal (6 s); nothing flashes.

looks.title: Cross beams
looks.intent: Beams from both walls lean in and cross high over the dance floor, above head height, like a lattice in the haze. The booth beams stay upright and dim behind.

looks.title: Red room
looks.intent: Deep red only and low: the columns and the press glow red from their feet, a dim red graze on the crane bridge, the booth beams stand still and dim. The DJ is a dark shape against the red press. The roof stays black.

looks.title: White cathedral
looks.intent: The whole nave in cold white: every column beam straight up in mirrored pairs, the wall beams up the walls, the crane bridge grazed white from the cut above, a narrow fan behind the DJ, who stands as a silhouette against the lit press.

looks.title: Laser into the roof
looks.intent: OPTIONAL, NOT IN THE LOOP. In the dark, red laser lines from the top of the cut into the roof frame, one dim red shaft behind the DJ. Needs a certified laser safety officer before it is ever switched on. LASER: off by default; requiresLaserSignOff: written at level 0, the laser stays dark until a human raises it after a certified laser safety officer signs off (Class 4, owed).

looks.title: Doors
looks.intent: Before the first act: haze up, the nave columns barely glowing amber from their feet, the press a dim silhouette. Enough to find your way, nothing that performs.

looks.title: The X
looks.intent: The X of PARs on the cut lights the DJ from above while the column beams cross the nave in an X high over the floor — the rig drawing its own sign.

looks.title: Tunnel
looks.intent: The ten column beams lean hard in from both walls and meet in a pointed arch high over the dance floor: a tunnel of white in the haze, the crowd underneath it.

looks.title: Green core
looks.intent: MOXIR's green, once: every nave column glows green from its foot and the press goes green behind the DJ, while a narrow white fan stands up behind the booth. The only colour in the night that is the brand's.

looks.title: Amber dust
looks.intent: The teaser's warm sodium light: amber up the columns and under the crane bridge, low, like dust in a factory afternoon. No beams. A breath between the white sections.

looks.title: Lights up
looks.intent: The end of the night: every column and the crane bridge in warm white at full, all beams off. Clean-out light, not a show look.

looks.title: The blade
looks.intent: The curtain at full white under the cut: in haze a sheet of cold white whose top edge is the cut's 15° slope; the four bridge PARs red at 60 % draw the crane as a frame. Nothing else.

looks.title: The hit
looks.intent: From black: the curtain and the six X PARs at full white together. No strobe channel (rates are untested on the PL5403) — the hit is the cue's own 0 s cut in and out.

looks.title: One shaft on the DJ
looks.intent: Black. The centre curtain PAR alone, full white, straight down on the DJ: one hard shaft from the cut, the DJ in it. Nothing else.

looks.title: White cathedral + the X
looks.intent: White cathedral with the X of PARs on the cut drawn over the DJ.

looks.title: Fan hit
looks.intent: From black, the seven booth beams open in a narrow white fan straight up behind the DJ. No sparks (no chart); the cue cuts in at 0 s.

looks.title: Monolith
looks.intent: The press stands up out of the dark: five PARs graze its faces from its foot in cold white, and far behind it, 50 m deep, one narrow white shaft, the lighthouse. Nothing else. The opening and rest look.

looks.title: Vista
looks.intent: The DJ against a 50 m tunnel: the eight PARs up the columns behind the press in cold white, near pair to far pair, the lighthouse at the end of them, and the centre booth beam backlighting the DJ at 30 %.

looks.title: Light box
looks.intent: The ten column-base beams lean inward at the policy's limit and light the roof lantern from inside as ten parallel planes; the crowd columns glow red at 20 %. The crowd stands under a glowing box; the gap over the DJ stays dark.

looks.title: Forest
looks.intent: Deep red only: the crowd columns and the neighbour-span columns at 60 %, the bridge red. The hall reads endless sideways. Everything else is dark.

looks.title: Crown
looks.intent: The climax, all white: the ten column beams lean into the lantern, the seven booth beams open in a fan behind the DJ, the vista and the lighthouse at full, the press lit. Nothing aims over the crowd.

looks.title: Roof cathedral
looks.intent: The hall's own architecture lit as a nave: every column-base beam rises straight up into the space frame in mirrored pairs, a slight lean in toward the centre line; the booth's beams open as an apse fan into the lantern above the press; the tower bee-eyes lift low over the house; the DJ keyed from both sides.

looks.title: Fan out
looks.intent: The booth's beams open in one symmetric fan over the house from behind the DJ; the column rows lean back toward the booth so every beam in the room reads from the machinery outward; the tower bee-eyes fan wide and low.

looks.title: Crossfire
looks.intent: The two column rows fire across the dance floor at each other and cross over the nave's centre line at 9 m; the four beams behind the DJ X-cross 12 m over the booth, the flank beams over the front of the crowd; the tower bee-eyes cross just in front of the barrier.

looks.title: All to centre
looks.intent: The ballyhoo focus, 16 m out from the booth, 9 m up: the flank beams, the bee-eyes and the column rows meet there (the booth's lamps over the booth's axis, the column rows over the nave's, 1.65 m apart — the booth is centred on the press, not on the hall); the four beams behind the DJ meet higher, 13 m straight over the booth, so none crosses the DJ.

looks.title: Curtain
looks.intent: A wall of light behind the DJ: the booth's beams stand straight up in front of the machinery, the tower bee-eyes straight up either side, the header spots straight down onto the booth; the column rows lean back to the booth.

looks.title: Blackout + one beam
looks.intent: Everything out but one: the apex beam, hung at the triangle's point over the pit, straight down — a white pillar between the crowd and the DJ, who stands behind it as a shape. The other six halo beams wait in the dark already turned to the next look (a move in black, never a move seen).

looks.title: Slow sweep
looks.intent: The halo opens OUTWARD to the crowd: all seven beams leave the triangle along its own directions, bent toward the house and dipped 24° under the horizon, over the heads of the floor; the column beams lean out to the walls in pairs, the columns and the bridge glow low red. A held frame of a slow sweep; nothing flashes.

looks.title: Red room
looks.intent: Deep red, and low: the apex and the four side beams stand round the DJ as a red cage landing on the floor 2.6 m out from him; the two base-corner beams cross in an X just over his head (3.1 m above the deck) and run on down past him — the X on the DJ. The columns, the press and the bridge glow red from below; the roof stays black.

looks.title: White cathedral
looks.intent: The cone on the DJ: all seven halo beams close in to a ring 1.3 m round the performer at deck height — a cone of cold white with the DJ standing untouched inside it; the column beams stand straight up in mirrored pairs down the nave. Everything else dark.

looks.title: Strobe hit
looks.intent: The peak: the two strobes on the halo's base edge flash out over the DJ into the crowd and the pit strobes rake up from the floor; every beam and PAR out so the flash lands on black. The halo beams keep the cone's aim, dark (no head moves under a strobe).

looks.intent: Deep red only, and low: the columns and the press glow from their feet, the booth's beams stand still and dim in red, the DJ a dark shape against the red press. The column beams are out: the roof stays black.

looks.title: Strobe hit
looks.intent: The peak: every strobe and blinder at full — the pit strobes rake up over the crowd from the floor, the header strobes and the blinders hit the front of the floor; every beam and PAR out, so the flash lands on black.

looks.intent: Everything out but one: the beam on the floor right behind the DJ, straight up into the roof — the DJ a silhouette cut out of it.

looks.title: Slow sweep
looks.intent: A held frame of a slow mirrored sweep: the column beams lean out toward the walls in pairs, the booth's line fans wide; the columns glow a low red underneath. Nothing flashes.

looks.title: Blackout + one shaft
looks.intent: Black. One thin white shaft stands straight up from behind the press into the roof, the DJ a silhouette cut out of it. Nothing else.

looks.title: Columns from below
looks.intent: The eight column faces glow cold white from their feet and fade to black before the roof; a low white beam at the foot of each far column. The floor is dark, the structure stands up out of it.

looks.title: Roof reveal
looks.intent: The space-frame roof appears in pieces: the beams behind the press fan open into the trusswork, then the column beams stand up beside them; a dim white graze along the crane bridge above. Still, no sweep.

looks.title: Slow fan
looks.intent: The column beams lean slowly in across the nave, the wall beams lean slowly out toward the side walls, the booth beams open into a wide fan up into the roof. The move is the slow crossfade in from the reveal (6 s); nothing flashes.

looks.title: Cross beams
looks.intent: Beams from both walls lean in and cross high over the dance floor, above head height, like a lattice in the haze. The booth beams stay upright and dim behind.

looks.title: Red room
looks.intent: Deep red only and low: the columns and the press glow red from their feet, a dim red graze on the crane bridge, the booth beams stand still and dim. The DJ is a dark shape against the red press. The roof stays black.

looks.title: White cathedral
looks.intent: The whole nave in cold white: every column beam straight up in mirrored pairs, the wall beams up the walls, the crane bridge grazed white from the cut above, a narrow fan behind the DJ, who stands as a silhouette against the lit press.

looks.title: Blinder hit
looks.intent: One hard white blinder hit on the front of the floor from the cut, cut in from black and cut back to black. The COB curtain is held steady by the look; the room flashes only by the cue cutting in and out. STROBE-CAPABLE: lights the blinder, held steady, cut by the cue; flash rate never above 3/s.

looks.title: White cathedral
looks.intent: The roof frame and the columns as a nave of cold white: the column beams stand straight up in mirrored pairs, the booth's line opens a narrow apse fan behind the DJ. Everything else is dark — no PAR, no spot, no strobe.

looks.title: Red room
looks.intent: Deep red only, and low: the columns and the press glow from their feet, the booth's beams stand still and dim in red, the DJ a dark shape against the red press. The column beams are out: the roof stays black.

looks.title: Strobe hit
looks.intent: The peak: every strobe and blinder at full — the pit strobes rake up over the crowd from the floor, the header strobes and the blinders hit the front of the floor; every beam and PAR out, so the flash lands on black.

looks.title: Blackout + one beam
looks.intent: Everything out but one: the beam on the floor right behind the DJ, straight up into the roof — the DJ a silhouette cut out of it.

looks.title: Slow sweep
looks.intent: A held frame of a slow mirrored sweep: the column beams lean out toward the walls in pairs, the booth's line fans wide; the columns glow a low red underneath. Nothing flashes.

looks.title: Blackout + one shaft
looks.intent: Black. One thin white shaft stands straight up from behind the press into the roof, the DJ a silhouette cut out of it. Nothing else.

looks.title: Columns from below
looks.intent: The eight column faces glow cold white from their feet and fade to black before the roof; a low white beam at the foot of each far column. The floor is dark, the structure stands up out of it.

looks.title: Roof reveal
looks.intent: The space-frame roof appears in pieces: the beams behind the press fan open into the trusswork, then the column beams stand up beside them; a dim white graze along the crane bridge above. Still, no sweep.

looks.title: Slow fan
looks.intent: The column beams lean slowly in across the nave, the wall beams lean slowly out toward the side walls, the booth beams open into a wide fan up into the roof. The move is the slow crossfade in from the reveal (6 s); nothing flashes.

looks.title: Cross beams
looks.intent: Beams from both walls lean in and cross high over the dance floor, above head height, like a lattice in the haze. The booth beams stay upright and dim behind.

looks.title: Red room
looks.intent: Deep red only and low: the columns and the press glow red from their feet, a dim red graze on the crane bridge, the booth beams stand still and dim. The DJ is a dark shape against the red press. The roof stays black.

looks.title: White cathedral
looks.intent: The whole nave in cold white: every column beam straight up in mirrored pairs, the wall beams up the walls, the crane bridge grazed white from the cut above, a narrow fan behind the DJ, who stands as a silhouette against the lit press.

looks.title: Blinder hit
looks.intent: One hard white blinder hit on the front of the floor from the cut, cut in from black and cut back to black. The COB curtain is held steady by the look; the room flashes only by the cue cutting in and out. STROBE-CAPABLE: lights the blinder, held steady, cut by the cue; flash rate never above 3/s.

looks.title: Haze wall
looks.intent: Haze rolls from behind the DJ; all seven booth beams stand straight up in a row, a wall of light in the haze behind the silhouette; the rest is dark. EFFECT: hazers on (hazer-back, hazer-hall) — NOT SIMULATED.

looks.title: Spark hit
looks.intent: From black: the booth beams open in a narrow white fan and back-light one burst of cold sparks rising in the pit in front of the silhouette; then black. (The sparks are not drawn in the room.) EFFECT: cold spark machines in the pit, one burst on the cue — NOT SIMULATED, plume height and clearance UNVALIDATED (maker manual owed).

looks.title: Laser into the roof
looks.intent: OPTIONAL, NOT IN THE LOOP. In the dark, red laser lines from the top of the cut into the roof frame, one dim red shaft behind the DJ. Needs a certified laser safety officer before it is ever switched on. LASER: off by default; requiresLaserSignOff: written at level 0, the laser stays dark until a human raises it after a certified laser safety officer signs off (Class 4, owed).

codeFiles.content:
MOXIR — ten truss versions

Truss and lights only. The truss is the object, the lights live on it, and nothing else is added. Every version uses the lights already on the rental list: 7 beams (B380F), 2 strobes and the PARs. Front views are from the dance floor, with the yellow crane at about 7.6 m and the DJ below. The press and machine line stand on the right, so anything low goes left. Sizes are standard truss lengths (2, 3, 4 m) and estimates; every hanging point is a chain hoist with a safety steel.

cranetrussbeampress / machines

1The X

truss
2 × 4 m + a centre crossing block, hung flat facing the crowd
lights
a beam on each of the 4 ends, 3 at the crossing, a strobe at the top and bottom
rig
2–3 hoists · ~8 m
feel
the sign. Strong, simple, maybe expected

2The X lying down

truss
2 × 5 m crossing flat (horizontal) at 6 m, one arm pointing into the crowd
lights
beams on all 4 ends fire in 4 directions; the X only reads from above, or in the haze as 4 rays
rig
4 hoists · ~10 m
feel
fresh: the sign is hidden, you feel it rather than see it

3The fallen X

truss
one 4 m arm hangs from the crane; the other 4 m arm stands on a base plate on the LEFT floor and leans into the crossing, tied off
lights
beams at the ends and at the crossing; one beam at the fallen foot shoots up through the crossing
rig
2 hoists + 1 ground point with barrier · ~8 m
feel
wild, broken, still MOXIR: the ruin of the sign

4The cut

truss
one straight 12 m line, a steep diagonal across the whole bridge: low on the left (≈4 m), high on the right (≈7 m, over the machines)
lights
the 7 beams spaced along it, each at a different height; strobes at both ends
rig
3 hoists · 12 m
feel
one gesture, a slash through the hall. Very minimal

5The spine

truss
side view: one 12 m line running ALONG the hall, from the crane over the DJ out over the dance floor, dipping slightly toward the crowd
lights
beams all along it, straight down into the crowd, one after another
rig
1 hoist at the crane + 2 more at the far end (a second crane point or a ground tower) · 12 m
feel
fresh: the light reaches out from the DJ into the people

6Halo

truss
a triangle of 3 × 4 m lying flat at 6 m, centred over the DJ
lights
beams on the corners all aim in to a point on the DJ: a cone of light around them, then open outward to the crowd
rig
3 hoists · 12 m + 3 corners
feel
ritual; strong focus on the DJ

7Arrow

truss
a triangle of 3 × 4 m hung upright, point down, aimed at the DJ
lights
a strobe at the point, beams along the top edge
rig
2 hoists · 12 m
feel
aggressive, graphic; close to a logo

8Organ

truss
5 vertical pieces (2–3 m) of different lengths hanging in a row, longest on the left, shortest over the machines
lights
a beam at the foot of each, 2 on the longest; they fire one by one like keys
rig
5 hoists · ~12 m
feel
the pendulum idea, turned into an instrument

9Portal ajar

truss
a 4 × 4 m square frame hung upright around the DJ, twisted about 20°, a door left half open
lights
beams on the top corners; strobes low on both sides, which make the frame flash as a silhouette
rig
2 hoists · 16 m + corners
feel
architectural; the DJ plays inside a door

10The gap

truss
two 6 m lines, the left one low (≈5 m) and the right one high (≈7 m, over the machines), with a 2 m gap right over the DJ
lights
the two inner beams meet in the gap on the DJ; the outer ones sweep the room
rig
4 hoists · 12 m
feel
a broken bridge; the DJ stands in the break

My advice

3, the fallen X. It is the MOXIR sign, it's broken and wild the way you described, and it's still only two pieces of truss, so it stays minimal. The fallen arm stands on the open left, away from the machines, and its foot beam firing up through the crossing gives the night a moment nobody forgets.

Next: 4, the cut (the most minimal: one line, one gesture) and 10, the gap (the DJ standing in a broken bridge). 2, the X lying down is the freshest if you want the sign hidden.

Any version: a rigger signs off the crane loads. Plan B if the crane is refused: the same truss on ground towers. Pick two or three and I build them in the 3D room so you can judge from the dance floor.
